overview: Black meets 2.h3 with ...e5 and ...c6, then after 4.d4 e4 5.c4 Bd6 6.Nc3 Ne7 builds a big pawn centre cramping White. White tries to undermine it with c4, Nc3 and Bg2 pressure while Black has space and a lead in development.

white_ideas.idea: Undermine the Black centre with d4 and c4
Use the long diagonal Bg2 against d5

black_ideas.idea: Build a big centre with ...e5, ...d5, ...e4 and ...c6
Keep the space edge and push the kingside

typical_structures.structure: Black pawn chain on c6, d5, e4 against White c4/d4

character.notes: Black has a space edge; unbalanced, with White the more at risk.

gambit.notes: No material is given on purpose in the main line.

soundness.notes: Considered dubious for White; Black gets a comfortable centre.

structure.notes: Locked chain on d5/e4 with Black space.

approach.notes: The Grob is rarely chosen by strong players.

character.reason: Unbalanced with White's flank pawn moves risky.

approach.reason: Strong players seldom play the Grob.
